findings.title: Lambda without active X-Ray tracing
findings.description: Without tracing_config { mode = "Active" }, Lambda invocations are not traced in X-Ray, reducing observability of failures and latency.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Lambda function URL without authorization
findings.description: A function URL with authorization_type NONE exposes the function as a public HTTPS endpoint. Require AWS_IAM.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Lambda function not deployed in a VPC
findings.description: Lambda functions without a vpc_config block run outside your VPC, with no security-group or network-ACL control over their network access. Functions accessing VPC resources (RDS, ElastiCache) should declare vpc_config with subnet_ids and security_group_ids.
findings.expected: vpc_config block with subnet_ids and security_group_ids
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Lambda function without reserved concurrent executions
findings.description: Hygiene: Lambda functions should set reserved_concurrent_executions to cap concurrency, preventing runaway scaling and unexpected cost. Set the attribute explicitly.
findings.expected: reserved_concurrent_executions set to an explicit value
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Lambda function without code signing
findings.description: An aws_lambda_function without a code_signing_config block deploys code without signature validation, so tampered deployment packages run unchecked. Enforce code signing with AWS Signer.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: Lambda function without dead-letter queue
findings.description: Hygiene: an aws_lambda_function without a dead_letter_config block silently drops asynchronously-invoked events that fail all retries. Route failed events to an SQS queue or SNS topic.
findings.remediation: Review the flagged configuration against AWS security best practices and the CIS AWS Foundations Benchmark. Apply the control the rule describes, preferring restrictive defaults, encryption, and audit logging. Validate with `aegis scan` after the change.

findings.title: IAM user uses an inline policy
findings.description: The user embeds an inline policy document instead of attaching a managed policy. Inline policies cannot be reused, versioned, or reviewed centrally. Prefer aws_iam_policy with aws_iam_user_policy_attachment.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.

findings.title: IAM user has no tags
findings.description: The IAM user carries no tags, making ownership, purpose, and lifecycle untraceable in audits and complicating attribute-based access control. Tag identities with at least owner and purpose.
findings.remediation: Apply least privilege. Replace wildcard (`*`) actions and resources with the minimum scoped ARNs the workload needs. Split policy authoring from attachment. Use IAM Access Analyzer to generate scoped policies from CloudTrail history.
